text:
tara: quick spike: ran a targeted traffic-slice for photon-11b int6 vs int8 on our reranker + summarizer flows. int6 looks great costwise but NDCG drop on long-query reranks. posting quick findings and proposal.

li: what's the slice definition? long-query = ? top-k?

tara: long-query = user queries where context tokens > 180. reranker used for top-10 -> top-5. dataset = 800 real sessions sampled from product logs.

sam: numbers pls (cost / quality / latency)

tara: short table:
- cost per 1M tokens: int8 $26.5, int6 $12.3 (approx using quant kernels + batching)
- latency median (rerank per-request): int8 260ms, int6 195ms
- NDCG@5 (rerank relevance): int8 0.78, int6 0.71 on long-query slice
- halluc/factual drift on summary step: int8 0.03, int6 0.06 (relative increase but still small in absolute terms)

dev: interesting. NDCG drop is concerning for search UX. any pattern in failure cases?

tara: yes. loss seems concentrated in queries with dense entity co-reference and multi-turn context (e.g., product config questions). The reranker under int6 tends to demote exact-entity matches in some cases.

li: could be quant noise affecting the final layer logits that determine fine-grained ranking. Have we tried per-channel vs symmetric quant? or LLM-lora calibration?

tara: not yet. planned per-channel int6 run next. Also trying a low-cost calibration step: 2000 in-domain pairs to fit small temperature + bias correction to reranker logits. early sims show NDCG bump ~+0.04 with calibration.

sam: what's the unit-econ if we do calibration + hybrid routing?

tara: assume hybrid: keep int6 for all except reranker-on-long queries (route reranker to int8 only). reranker token share is ~12% of tokens, long-query fraction ~20% of requests but 55% of tokens. reranker-specific tokens among long queries ~30% of that token mass. rough calc: total token mass that must be int8 under hybrid ~= 0.55*0.30 = 0.165 (16.5%). cost -> 0.835*12.3 + 0.165*26.5 = 13.98 $/1M tokens. calibration adds infra cost (one-off): ~ $1k for the tuning run, negligible at scale.

dev: from infra POV, hybrid routing is ok. we can route by metadata: context_length > 180 && path == reranker -> int8. need per-route metrics.

devex: I'll add a route:photon-rerank-long to console with NDCG@5, latency p95, cost/1M tokens. also add a canary flag.

ops-bot: Canary started for flag:photon-hybrid-rerank at 2026-03-23T18:12:05Z. target 3% traffic.

li: propose evaluation plan: 1) micro-bakeoff per-channel vs symmetric int6; 2) calibration experiment (temp/bias) on 2k pairs; 3) priming stability shift tests +/- 10 tokens; 4) offline rerun of full 10k long-query evaluation with automated relevance labels and human audit on 200 borderline cases.

tara: sched plan: kick off per-channel run now, calibration tomorrow, then canary metrics after 6 hours. command I'll run: 
```
python tools/eval/rerank_bakeoff.py --model photon-11b --quant int6 --variants perchannel,symmetric --slice long-query --out /tmp/photon_rerank_bakeoff.json --seed 2026
```

sam: please include logits histograms and delta-ks tests between int8 and int6. that's the smoking gun for distribution shift.

li: also add a simple reranker fallback policy: if top1 score delta (int6 vs baseline) < -0.08 then fallback to int8 for that query. can test in canary.

tara: good idea. ops: can the canary implement per-request fallback?

dev: yes, we have a per-request fallback primitive. ops-bot will annotate events. devex: add alerting rule: if NDCG@5 drop > 0.03 or user-visible regression count > 5 in 30m -> pause rollout.

devex: done. gating thresholds added. also adding a quick one-click rollback link in the canary dashboard.

sam: product check: are we comfortable with 14$/1M token steady-state if reranker hybrid passes? that's ~47% cost savings vs full int8.

sam: product asks for example failure cases to evaluate UX impact. tara can you paste 3 anonymized cases where int6 rerank mis-ordered results?

tara: will paste 3 in canary brief.

li: final ask: include kl/emd between int8 logits and int6 logits per-layer for the top-k tokens. if drift localizes to final layers we can try small-head re-scaling.

tara: queued. will report back with per-channel results and calibration outcomes by 3291112280. :mag_right:
